data.name: Sonalal
data.gender_notes: Sonalal is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sonalal is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chandra’, which means ‘Moon’. Sonalal is a beautiful name for a baby girl, signifying the beauty of the moon. The name Sonalal signifies calmness and gentleness, making it a perfect name for a girl who is gentle and peaceful. The name Sonalal carries the meaning “Son of Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sonalal usually hope their child will grow to embody son of moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sonalal is a spiritual name that signifies the connection between the divine energy of the moon and the soul of the child. It is believed that children with this name are blessed with the qualities of the moon, such as calmness, gentleness, and nurturing abilities.
data.etymology: Sonalal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Son of Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sonalal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
